name: Wormhost Surgeon

source.note: The Crooked Moon (Legends of Avantris), appendix A. Numbers are the book's; the words are ours.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.summary: Regains 10 Hit Points at the start of its turns; Poison damage stops that for its next turn. Dies only if it starts a turn at 0 HP and doesn't regenerate.
traits.text: The surgeon regains 10 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns. If it takes Poison damage, this doesn't work at the start of its next turn. It dies only if it starts its turn at 0 Hit Points and doesn't regenerate.

traits.name: Veiled Ignorance
traits.summary: A creature with an unreadable mind, or under Mind Blank or Nondetection, is Invisible to it (its Blindsight doesn't help).
traits.text: A creature whose mind can't be read, or that is under Mind Blank or Nondetection, has the Invisible condition toward the surgeon, and the surgeon's Blindsight ignores this.

actions.name: Bone Saw
actions.summary: +7, 1d6+4 Slashing plus 1d8 Psychic; on a critical hit the target's Intelligence drops by 1d4 (death at 0).
actions.text: Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) Slashing plus 4 (1d8) Psychic damage. On a critical hit the target's Intelligence score drops by 1d4, and it dies if that brings the score to 0.

actions.name: Infested Spray
actions.summary: Recharge 5-6. 20-ft cone, DC 14 Dex save: 5d6 Psychic and parasites that deal 2d6 Psychic at each turn end until Poison damage or a cure; half damage and no worms on a success. A creature killed by the worms dies, and a Humanoid rises 24 hours later as a surgeon.
actions.text: Dexterity save, DC 14, for each creature in a 20-foot cone. Failure: 17 (5d6) Psychic damage, and larval worms burrow in: the target takes 7 (2d6) Psychic damage at the end of each of its turns until it takes Poison damage or an effect that ends the Poisoned condition targets it. Success: half damage only. A target reduced to 0 Hit Points by the worms' Psychic damage dies, and a Humanoid so slain rises 24 hours later as a wormhost surgeon.

reactions.name: Protective Parasite
reactions.trigger: The surgeon is reduced to 0 Hit Points.
reactions.summary: When reduced to 0 HP: the brain-worm spits acid down a 20-ft by 5-ft line, DC 14 Dex save for 3d6 Acid (half on a success).
reactions.text: When the surgeon drops to 0 Hit Points, the parasite in its brain spits acid along a 20-foot by 5-foot line. Dexterity save, DC 14: 10 (3d6) Acid damage on a failure, half on a success.

summary: A possessed doctor whose exposed brain hosts a parasite: it saws with two blades, sprays infesting fluid in a cone, regrows wounds and bursts with acid when it falls.
